mode: SIMULATED/PAPER - no live orders. This config must never contain secrets.

feedexec.policy_contract: FROZEN policy only (confirmed_dd_guard, v29-iso4 chain). No threshold/architecture/frequency changes. This module owns FEED + EXECUTION plumbing, not decisions.

feed.doc_ref: Binance Open Platform, USD-S-M Futures Market Data REST API, 'Kline Candlestick Data': GET /fapi/v1/klines (base https://fapi.binance.com). Verified 2026-09-11 via developers.binance.com/docs/derivatives/usds-margined-futures/market-data/rest-api/Kline-Candlestick-Data.
feed.prior_fix: Round75 used Spot https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines - INCONSISTENT with USD-M BTCUSDT research. Fixed here to the official USD-M (fapi) endpoint.
feed.auth: none - public market-data GET only, no keys, no orders
feed.forming_candle: dropped - only closed candles (close_time <= now) are ingested
feed.timestamps: observed_at (when fetched) recorded separately from decision_time (when the policy clock fires). Never conflated.

decision_clock.stride_source: feedexec-local-declared (W1 manifest absent: artifacts/research/opencode_r76_real_inference/manifest/ is empty as of 2026-09-11; no anchor/stride found to respect, so this config's declared stride applies and is recorded here)
decision_clock.rule: Full inference runs ONLY on bars where (bar_index - anchor) % stride == 0. Other closed bars are ingested for execution settlement with status SKIP_CLOCK - never a full decision.

execution.entry: next-bar: entry sought strictly on bars > signal_bar, window signal+1..signal+entry_expiry_bars, then cancel EXPIRED
execution.tp_rule: TP1 50% partial exit FIRST, remainder runs to TP2 (fixes the documented v1/v2/v21 TP1 omission)
execution.entry_bar_suppression: targets suppressed on the intrabar entry candle unless entered at/through the open (engine ohlc-v2 lines ~291-294)
execution.timeout: exit at the timeout bar's open, funding charged first if funding time; reason time_after_tp1 when TP1 already done else time
execution.truncated_window: replay mode with known horizon rejects entries whose entry+holding exceeds the horizon (TRUNCATED, engine parity); fresh open-ended mode has no truncation

costs.note: Stop/timeout exits are market-like at the scenario fee, NOT guaranteed maker/limit fills. No maker-fill or queue-position claims from OHLC.

control_account.name: iso4_only_1x
control_account.rule: CAUSAL SEPARATE account: ungated 1x mirror that takes every admitted signal and settles on the same closed bars. Own REALIZED equity only - the invalid rebased-future expected-equity reference is DROPPED in fresh mode.
control_account.causality: guard reads control equity realized on bars <= current bar only. Never future, never rebased.
control_account.sizing: fixed 1x always (guard leverage plays only on the operating account)

guard.name: dd_guard
guard.reference: scripts/opencode_risk_overlay_probe.py:47-61 (lev = 0.5 while past-only realized equity is >10% under its trailing peak, else 1.0). Reuses v1.DdGuard code UNMODIFIED.

divergence.reference: control account iso4_only_1x realized equity (causal, past-only, no future curve). Reuses v2.1 OneSidedDivergenceMonitor.check() logic UNMODIFIED; only expected_at() is repointed from the frozen curve to the causal control account.
divergence.precedence: divergence latch, then daily halt, then max-position (busy)

kill_switch.note: UTC-day loss halts NEW intents for the rest of the day (positions still managed to exit); max_positions=1 asserted fail-closed. Reuses v2.DailyLossHalt + v2.MaxPositionGuard code UNMODIFIED.

manifests.fresh: artifacts/research/opencode_r76_real_inference/feedexec/fresh_manifest.json (fresh observations; REFUSES replay inputs - no stored signals/predictions/control-exit CSVs, no bar-index matching)
manifests.rule: Historical replay vs fresh observations get DISTINCT manifests. Never mixed in one run.

state.note: Snapshot covers operating + control accounts (open with partial state, pending) so restart resumes bit-identical.

changelog.change: FEED endpoint Spot https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines -> official USD-M https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/klines (doc-verified).
EXECUTION adds TP1 50% partial exit THEN TP2 (engine parity). Prior paper took FULL position off at TP2 (documented simplification) - that simplification is REMOVED here.
DIVERGENCE reference: rebased frozen future curve -> causal separate control account iso4_only_1x realized equity (UNDER-only 5% trip kept, genuine risk guard).
MANIFESTS split: replay vs fresh are distinct files with distinct kinds; fresh mode fail-closes on any replay input.
CLOCK: full decision only on anchor/stride bars (declared stride 12, W1 manifest absent); other bars SKIP_CLOCK.
No-op carryovers kept identical: stop-first, entry-bar suppression, fees/funding/timeout math, one-position invariant, daily-halt + divergence-trip guards (reused code).
